chunks: He raised his parents onto the throne, and they fell down before him in prostration. He said, 'O my father, this is the interpretation of my vision from before; my Lord has made it come true. He was gracious to me when He brought me out of prison and brought you from the desert after Satan had created discord between me and my brothers. Indeed, my Lord is subtle in what He wills; indeed, it is He who is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.'

key_terms.الْبَدْوِ: The desert or countryside, referring to the place of origin
key_terms.الْعَرْشِ: The throne, symbolizing high status and authority
key_terms.تَأْوِيلُ: Interpretation or explanation of a dream or vision
key_terms.لَطِيفٌ: Subtle, gentle, or skillful in dealing with creation

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Joseph's dream and how was it fulfilled according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Joseph (AS) fulfills his childhood dream of eleven stars, the sun, and the moon prostrating to him, which Shia scholars interpret as a prophecy of his family's eventual reverence. He attributes this triumph to Allah's grace in extracting him from prison and bringing his parents from the desert, highlighting the transition from Satan's incitement of discord to divine wisdom. The act of prostration by his parents is often viewed in Tafsir as a sign of honor and recognition of his prophetic status rather than worship.
